newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Ecogas set to be launched.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Ecogas set to be launched.

text.p: Ecogas, the gas distribution company which has been hived off from Colombia's state-run oil company Ecopetrol, will be formally inaugurated next week, officials said Friday.

President Ernesto Samper, Mines and Energy Minister Rodrigo Villamizar, Ecopetrol chairman Antonio Urdinola and Ecogas chairman Alejandro Rengifo will attend the opening of the company's official headquarters in northeast Bucaramanga on Wednesday, Aug. 20.

Ecogas will remain in state hands but will have autonomy over day-to-day decision-making. The powerful oil workers' union USO had initially opposed the division of Ecopetrol into oil and gas operations, arguing that it was a halfway house on the road to the eventual break-up of Ecopetrol and its potential privatization.

Ecogas will be the country's largest gas distribution company and will supply more than three million domestic and commercial consumers. It will control a 2,500 mile (4,000 km) network of gas pipelines and aims to cover 300 muncipalities, about one-third of the country by the turn of the century.
